title: HHS-04-R1: Completed department-wide cross-component AAR remains unacquired
publisher: Named U.S. government agencies and the U.S. Government Accountability Office
summary: GAO reports that HHS established a January 2026 SOP and was awaiting a qualifying exercise or response AAR for review. No completed department-wide AAR naming participating HHS components was located. The missing evidence is now a completed use record, not another template or general emergency plan.
